sentences.en: The continuous and reckless use of synthetic chemicals for the control of pests which pose a threat to agricultural crops and human health is proving to be counter-productive.

sentences.en: Apart from engendering widespread ecological disorders, pesticides have contributed to the emergence of a new breed of chemical-resistant, highly lethal superbugs.
sentences.zh: 除了造成普遍的生态失调之外,杀虫剂还促成新品种的耐化学品、高致命性超级虫虫的出现。

sentences.en: According to a recent study by the Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO), more than 300 species of agricultural pests have developed resistance to a wide range of potent chemicals.

sentences.en: Most of the pesticides in the market today remain inadequately tested for properties that cause cancer and mutations as well as for other adverse effects on health, says a study by United States environmental agencies.
sentences.zh: 美国环保机构的一项研究指出,如今市场上的大多数杀虫剂仍然对引起癌症和突变的特性以及对健康的其他不利影响进行测试不足,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The United States National Resource Defense Council has found that DDT was the most popular of a long list of dangerous chemicals in use.
sentences.zh: 美国国家资源防务理事会发现,滴滴涕是使用中危险化学品长长清单中最受欢迎的化学品。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In the face of the escalating perils from indiscriminate applications of pesticides, a more effective and ecologically sound strategy of biological control, involving the selective use of natural enemies of the pest population, is fast gaining popularity – though, as yet, it is a new field with limited potential.
sentences.zh: 面对滥用杀虫剂的危险不断升级,一项更有效、生态上无害的生物控制战略,涉及有选择地使用害虫人口的自然敌人,正在迅速受到欢迎 — — 尽管它目前是一个潜力有限的新领域。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: The advantage of biological control in contrast to other methods is that it provides a relatively low-cost, perpetual control system with a minimum of detrimental side-effects.
sentences.zh: 与其他方法相比,生物控制的好处是,它提供了一个成本相对较低、长期的控制系统,其有害副作用最小。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: When handled by experts, bio-control is safe, non-polluting and self-dispersing.
sentences.zh: 由专家处理时,生物控制是安全的、无污染的和自我分散的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The Commonwealth Institute of Biological Control (CIBC) in Bangalore, with its global network of research laboratories and field stations, is one of the most active, non-commercial research agencies engaged in pest control by setting natural predators against parasites.
sentences.zh: 班加罗尔的英联邦生物控制研究所及其全球研究实验室和实地站网络,是从事虫害防治的最活跃的非商业性研究机构之一,它使天然捕食者对寄生虫进行防治。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: CIBC also serves as a clearing-house for the export and import of biological agents for pest control world-wide.
sentences.zh: CIBC还充当全世界用于虫害防治的生物制剂进出口的信息交换所。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: CIBC successfully used a seed-feeding weevil, native to Mexico, to control the obnoxious parthenium weed, known to exert devious influence on agriculture and human health in both India and Australia.
sentences.zh: CIBC成功地利用墨西哥本地的种子喂养恶毒病毒控制了已知在印度和澳大利亚对农业和人类健康产生下流影响的恶性杂草。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Similarly the Hyderabad-based Regional Research Laboratory (RRL), supported by CIBC, is now trying out an Argentinian weevil for the eradication of water hyacinth, another dangerous weed, which has become a nuisance in many parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 同样,设在海得拉巴的区域研究实验室在CIBC的支持下,正在试图找出阿根廷人为根除水烟而作的恶行,水烟是另一个危险的杂草,在世界许多地方,这已成为一种麻烦。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: According to Mrs Kaiser Jamil of RRL, ‘The Argentinian weevil does not attack any other plant and a pair of adult bugs could destroy the weed in 4-5 days.’ CIBC is also perfecting the technique for breeding parasites that prey on ‘disapene scale’ insects – notorious defoliants of fruit trees in the US and India.
sentences.zh: 英国皇家空军的凯泽·贾米尔夫人认为,“阿根廷的邪恶不会攻击任何其他植物,一对成年虫子可以在4-5天之内消灭大麻。 ”英国皇家空军还正在完善培育寄生虫的技术,这些寄生虫是捕食“排泄物规模”的昆虫 — — 在美国和印度,这些昆虫是著名的果树脱叶剂。
